name: presheafHomSectionsEquiv

name: PresheafHom.isAmalgamation_iff
statement: C} (S : Sieve X) (x : Presieve.FamilyOfElements (presheafHom F G) S.arrows) (hx : x.Compatible) (y : (presheafHom F G).obj (op X)) : x.IsAmalgamation y ↔ ∀ (Y : C) (g : Y ⟶ X) (hg : S g), y.app (op (Over.mk g)) = (x g hg).app (op (Over.mk (𝟙 Y)))

statement: x.Compatible) (g : Y ⟶ X) : ∃ (φ : F.obj (op Y) ⟶ G.obj (op Y)), ∀ {Z : C} (p : Z ⟶ Y) (hp : S (p ≫ g)), φ ≫ G.map p.op = F.map p.op ≫ (x (p ≫ g) hp).app ⟨Over.mk (𝟙 Z)⟩
